_help: One entry per rating list. 'anchors' maps engine names (exactly as in your PGN) to their current CCRL rating on the matching CCRL list. See README.md.

lists.name: Blitz
lists.description: Fast games at 2 minutes + 1 second, calibrated to the CCRL Blitz scale.
lists.hardware: Describe your CPU here, e.g. Ryzen 9 7950X, 1 thread per engine
lists.settings: Ponder off, 128 MB hash per thread (same for all engines), AVT2026d opening book (12 moves per side), tablebase adjudication

lists.name: Classical
lists.description: Longer games at 12 minutes + 8 seconds, calibrated to the CCRL 40/15 scale.
lists.hardware: Describe your CPU here, e.g. Ryzen 9 7950X, 1 thread per engine
lists.settings: Ponder off, 256 MB hash per thread (same for all engines), AVT2026d opening book (12 moves per side), tablebase adjudication
